chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakūnī:
That the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, when he went out to the Eid, would not return by the path in which he had begun; he would take a different path.

key_terms.السَّكُونِيِّ: al-Sakūnī, the narrator to whom this report is attributed
key_terms.النَّبِيَّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْعِيدِ: the Eid occasion and its prayer gathering
key_terms.غَيْرِهِ: other than it; a different one

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم return from the Eid prayer by the same الطريق?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a sunnah (prophetic tradition) of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم concerning going out for the Eid prayer. He would return by a different route, indicating a practiced etiquette connected to the Eid salat.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1475 - In the narration of al-Sakuni, it is reported that
"When The Prophet (sw) went out for the Eid prayer, he would not return by the same path he took to go out; he would take a different path."
